question: What effect on speech and vital forces can be produced through this practice?
premises: Wind and related forces can be destroyed
The subject remains like a mute
inference: By destroying wind and related forces, one can render a person mute in speech.
uncertainties: The exact referent of vāyvādeḥ in this ritual context is unclear
plain_english: One should destroy the wind and so forth; then he stands mute in speech.
